items.text: Its a fun concept but WAY too tedious for people without literal days to sink into learning a new game. The space flight mechanic is absolutely what killed it for me. It is the most time consuming and boring way to implement space travel in a game that I have ever seen. I enjoy complex games but this was just beyond the fun threshold. If they ditched the space travel mechanic or added an option to choose between vanilla space travel and "fast travel" and an auto docking or manual docking option I would revisit but for now it is a refund me please type of game.
items.text_zh: 这是个有趣的构思，但对于没有真正几天时间投入学习新游戏的人来说，实在太繁琐了。太空飞行机制绝对是让我放弃的原因。这是我见过的游戏中实现太空旅行最耗时和最无聊的方式。我喜欢复杂的游戏，但这已经超出了乐趣的阈值。如果他们放弃太空飞行机制，或者增加一个选项让玩家在普通太空旅行和“快速旅行”之间选择，以及自动对接或手动对接的选项，我会重新考虑，但就目前而言，这是一款请给我退款类型的游戏。

observations.description: 太空飞行机制耗时且无聊
observations.evidence: The space flight mechanic is absolutely what killed it for me. It is the most time consuming and boring way to implement space travel in a game that I have ever seen.
